title: Complex analytic spaces and coherent sheaves
author: Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic)
description: Several complex variables from the Cauchy formula to Oka's and Cartan's coherence theorems, the local parametrization theorem and Nullstellensatz, complex spaces, the Dolbeault complex, Hörmander's L2 estimates, Cartan's Theorems A and B on Stein manifolds, and the Cartan-Serre finiteness theorem on compact complex spaces.
prerequisites: AG-QC lessons on sheaf cohomology and on complex analytic spaces
free_sources: Demailly, Complex Analytic and Differential Geometry (2012)
Lebl, Tasty Bits of Several Complex Variables v4.4
